description: This file is an Entity Framework Core migration class defining the initial database schema for the eShopWeb application. It includes creation of sequences, tables (Baskets, CatalogBrands, CatalogTypes, Orders, BasketItems, Catalog, OrderItems), constraints, indexes, and the corresponding drop operations in the Down method.

classes.name: InitialModel
classes.description: A partial class extending Migration, representing the initial database schema migration.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to apply this migration, creating sequences, tables, constraints, and indexes.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Defines the operations to revert this migration, dropping tables and sequences.
